repos.name: fflood-nep
repos.description: Sentinel-1 SAR flood-extent mapping for the 2026 Rasuwa/Bhote Koshi flash flood

repos.name: Road-Centerline
repos.description: Extract road centerlines from polygon geometries (road contours) — worldwide, in any input CRS, in any format geopandas can read or write.

repos.name: wildfire-copilot
repos.description: Agentic RAG over Wildfire Risk & Utility Vegetation Data

repos.name: geomlint
repos.description: Continuous validity, topology, and CRS-sanity checks for vector geospatial data — Monte Carlo for geometry columns.

repos.name: surge-exposure
repos.description: A reproducible data-engineering pipeline that ingests NOAA National Storm Surge Risk (MEOW/MOM) layers and NOAA NWPS flood-inundation polygons, overlays them against building/infrastructure footprints from Overture Maps (GeoParquet), and produces per-asset exposure scores plus an interactive map and an API endpoint. Optionally enriched with FEMA NF

repos.name: compound-risk-pbc
repos.description: A small client-side web application for visualizing compound risk (probability-based combination) using interactive charts and a lightweight UI.

repos.name: gtfs-transit-platform
repos.description: A generalized data-engineering and geospatial-analytics platform for GTFS transit feeds — ingest any agency's schedule data, run real spatial and service-quality analysis on it, and explore the results in an interactive map app deployed straight from this repo to GitHub Pages.

repos.name: fv-gwr
repos.description: Analysis code for Urban–Rural Exposure to Flood Hazard and Social Vulnerability in the Conterminous United States.

repos.name: 3d-export
repos.description: A Python-first tool to generate land cover exports and quickly create a 3D-style PNG from Sentinel-2 land cover tiles. Inspired by the original rayshader R workflow.

repos.name: RomanNepaliAI
repos.description: Tools for working with Nepali text in three directions: transliteration (romanized Nepali ↔ Devanagari script, same language) and translation (Nepali ↔ English, different languages). Built for subtitles, texting-style Nepali, and general text, with a CLI, a web demo, and a small backend API.

repos.name: GeoCoder
repos.description: Tools for turning a spreadsheet of US street addresses into geocoded points (and optionally OSM building footprint polygons), using the free Nominatim and Overpass OpenStreetMap APIs. No API key required for either service.

repos.name: 3DEP-Lidar-Terrain-Builder
repos.description: Generate DEM, DSM, hillshade, slope, aspect, and contour products from USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) lidar for a user-defined area of interest (AOI).

repos.name: hazard-mcp
repos.description: An MCP server (Python, FastMCP) that unifies multiple US hazard APIs behind a single agent-facing interface: OpenFEMA disaster declarations + NFIP claims, USGS earthquake GeoJSON feeds, NOAA NWPS river gauges + live flood-inundation extent, NWS weather alerts, and NASA EONET wildfire events + FIRMS fire detections.

repos.name: geospatial-data-copilot
repos.description: A natural-language interface over spatial/infrastructure data. Ask a question in plain English about San Francisco's utility infrastructure (poles, transmission towers, transformers) — a local LLM agent translates it into a spatial SQL query, runs it, and answers with a natural-language summary and an optional interactive map.

repos.name: conversational-ai-assistant
repos.description: A LangChain-based conversational chatbot with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). It indexes local documents into a Chroma vector database for semantic search, and answers questions in a context-aware, multi-turn conversation — grounding every answer in the retrieved source material and citing which file(s) it used.

repos.name: Air-Pollution-in-Florida
repos.description: Air Pollution in Florida: Dashboard for Visualization of Mean Daily  Average Fine Particular Matter (PM2.5) with Automatic Update Tool
